name: messaging-send-notification-only-vs-data-only-accepted
description: firebase-admin/messaging send() to a topic with ONLY a notification block, and separately with ONLY a data block: FCM accepts both and returns the same projects/<projectId>/messages/<numeric id> resource-name shape; neither a data nor a notification block is individually required. Cited by messaging-admin#4, messaging-admin#11, messaging-admin#16 (surface climbing under CDD; cited, not yet replayed).
